title: Daily digest: INTUC to Hold 34th Plenary in Delhi from | CITU urges voters to support Left party  | Brazil's Flavio Bolsonaro headed to U.S.
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: INTUC to Hold 34th Plenary in Delhi from Dec 1; Over 8,000 Delegates to Attend.
CITU has sought voters to support Left party candidates in GVMC polls.
Brazil's Flavio Bolsonaro headed to U.S. after losing election, sources say.
bullets_ur: INTUC Delhi mein Dec 1; se 8,000 Delegates par Attend ko 34th Plenary ka inqiad karenge.
CITU ne voters se GVMC intikhabat mein Left party ke ummeedwaron ki himayat ki apil ki hai.
Sources ke mutabiq, election haarne ke baad Brazil ke Flavio Bolsonaro America rawana ho gaye hain.
